title: Throttle chat streaming renders and cache markdown turn output
description: Vetted from Audit #7 findings 1.1 and 1.2. Chat rendering currently calls StateHasChanged per streaming delta and re-renders markdown for all turns each cycle. Implement throttled render ticks (target 4-8Hz), delta buffering, and per-turn rendered markdown caching keyed by stable turn identity/hash. Include regression tests and a measurable render-latency improvement target.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed render-throttle and markdown-cache contract with focused regression coverage. Evidence: Chat.razor enforces StreamRenderInterval=150ms and bounded non-streaming turn render cache; tests added in MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs (ChatRazor_DefinesStreamingRenderThrottleInterval, ChatRazor_RenderTurnContent_UsesBoundedCacheWithStreamingBypass). Validation: dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~ChatRazor_DefinesStreamingRenderThrottleInterval|Name~ChatRazor_RenderTurnContent_UsesBoundedCacheWithStreamingBypass".
